title: Space booking pages and receipts carry "Made with Frequency"

source.ref: Frequency Launch Build Brief, owner, 2026-10-06; gap report /mnt/project-files/launch/2026-10-06-launch-sweep.md

detail: WORKSTREAM 6 of the launch brief (ADR-1720). TODAY: the only "Made with" or "Powered by" mark is on the QR splash (lib/qr/splash-render.ts:86). The Space booking page (app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/(profile)/book/page.tsx), booking emails (lib/spaces/booking-notify.ts) and order receipts (lib/commerce/order-receipt.ts) carry none. THE FIX: one small shared mark linking to the home page with a UTM, on the booking page and in booking and order receipts. Name per docs/NAMING.md.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path");const r=f=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const walk=(d,o=[])=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return o;for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const q=p.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()){if(e.name!=="node_modules")walk(q,o)}else if(/\.(tsx?|mjs|md)$/.test(e.name))o.push(q)}return o};const fail=m=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const ID="LIVE-804";const f=["app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/(profile)/book/page.tsx","lib/spaces/booking-notify.ts","lib/commerce/order-receipt.ts"];const has=x=>{const s=r(x);if(/Made with Frequency/.test(s))return true;const imps=[...s.matchAll(/from \"@\/([^\"]+)\"/g)].map(m=>m[1]);return imps.some(i=>[i+".tsx",i+".ts"].some(c=>/Made with Frequency/.test(r(c))))};const miss=f.filter(x=>!has(x));if(miss.length)fail(ID+": no \"Made with Frequency\" on "+miss.join(", "))'
verify.note: Fails while the booking page, booking email or order receipt (or a module each imports directly) lacks the mark.
